column1: # Labeled cases for scripts/jev-triage.sh --replay-surface, built from capability signals, audit issues, and saved vendor pages.
# yes: the excerpt adds, removes, renames, or alters a project-scoped config surface. no: UI, CLI UX, models, packaging, or user-level changes.

column3: excerpt
Pin the default model for this repo.
Set triggers: [user] to prevent the agent from invoking a skill on its own.
permissionMode controls approval behavior for Subagent tool calls.
File-based agents can define lifecycle hooks that run at specific points during execution.
Add an executable .agents/setup shell script at the repository root.
A Markdown agent can list hook files in its front matter with a hooks: entry.
Setting mcpServers: [] excludes every MCP server, even globally configured ones.
Create a file named .geminiignore in the root of your project directory.
Added "attribution": false in settings.json to hide all commit and PR attribution; older CLI versions skip a settings file that holds it, so keep the object form in files shared across versions
channel_enabled: "Enable this MCP server as a channel (equivalent to --channels)"
A disabled server remains configured but is not used by Copilot. This setting persists across sessions.
The Amp CLI is now @ampcode/cli (was @sourcegraph/amp).
A new "Toggle Between Light/Dark Themes" command flips the theme without a trip to Settings.
Refreshed the model catalog: still 209 providers, 6,188 to 6,237 models. The Cline Pass tier gains cline-pass/mimo-v2.6-flash and cline-pass/mimo-v2.6-pro.
The Conversation API returns skill loads as read_skill actions.
GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna now support a 1M token context window, up from 272K, in the Kiro IDE, CLI, and Web.
Supports an optional `matcher` field that filters by agent name. The value is treated as a regular expression wrapped as `^(?:matcher)$` and tested against `agentName`.
Security Review is available today. It reads every pull request in the context of the codebase and posts one review comment reporting exploitable bugs.
Recipes can come from your workspace (`.kiro/workflows/`), your user configuration, recipes synchronized for your account, or the set bundled with Kiro.
Bugbot reads `.cursor/config/bugbot.yaml` from the default branch at the repo root.
To share a plugin through a repository, list it under `enabledPlugins` in `.claude/settings.json` or place it under `.claude/skills/`.
When a session starts with a skill named verify or simplify in place, Claude Code’s commit instructions tell Claude to run it
When the session sandbox is enabled, command hooks from the repository, your user settings, and plugins run inside it
Default image-generation model that the `GenerateImage` tool tries first. ... a user, project, or folder value overrides it.
autoCompactWindow : a number of tokens from 100000 to 1000000 , or "auto" for the window tuned for the model. /autocompact saves here.
To share rules stored outside .agents/rules/ or to include nested subdirectories of rules while preserving their YAML frontmatter and triggers, create .agents/rules.json
to share the dynamic workflow with everyone working in a repository, copy the directory containing the extension.mjs file into the .github/extensions/ directory
In V3, workspace, global, and MCP prompts appear in slash-command completion.
Choose a separate model for automatic project memory saves with the new `memory_model` setting in `kilo.jsonc`.
`<workspace>/.cursor/sandbox.json` | Single workspace (per-repo) | Higher. Commit it when the project should share the same sandbox rules.
In **Accept Edits mode**, file edits within the workspace are auto-approved, but shell commands and writes outside the workspace still prompt.
Project-scope: .junie/models/*.json.
Added `onFailure: "block"` for command and HTTP hooks: a hook that can't start, times out, or exits with an unexpected code blocks the action instead of letting it through
In V3 sessions, Hooks that run before or after a tool can now match by category, such as shell, read, write, or a specific MCP server or tool, instead of only by internal tool ID.
The .agents skill directory (that is, .agents/skills/) is a convention-based directory specified by Agent Skills for storing skills.
Added `autoCompactWindow` to subagent frontmatter and `--agents` definitions, so a subagent can auto-compact earlier than the main conversation's window
`enabledPlugins` | object | `{}` | Yes | Plugin enablement mapping (plugin ID → true/false).
V1 plugin implementations do not run in V2. Moving a file or renaming its config entry is not enough.
V2 does not place server names directly under mcp.
disable-model-invocation Set to true for the same effect as opencode/autoinvoke: false
By default this is `~/.copilot/hooks/` on macOS and Linux, or `%USERPROFILE%\.copilot\hooks\` on Windows.
prompt.autocomplete The user types in the prompt box and a word ends at the cursor.
SessionStart Fires once when a new conversation session starts, before the first model invocation. Handlers are a list directly under the event key in the project hooks file.
Both clients read `sandbox.json` at global and project levels. A repository you clone cannot use its project file to open network access or disable an active global sandbox policy.
Idle compaction compacts a long conversation that you've stepped away from, shortly before its prompt cache expires. Scope: Any file. Default: true.

| `enabledTools` | `string[]` | Tool names to allow from this server. When the list is non-empty, only these tools are loaded. |
For simultaneous code changes, give each task its own Git worktree.

Set a server’s protocol to talk to one built on the 2026-07-28 revision: opencode.jsonc { "$schema" : "https://opencode.ai/config.json" , "mcp" : { "servers" : { "modern" : { "type" : "remote" , "url" : "https://mcp.example.com/mcp" , "protocol" : "auto" , }, }, }, }
Enable the experimental portable shell scanner with: { "$schema" : "https://opencode.ai/config.json" , "experimental" : { "portable_shell_scanner" : true , }, }
V1 asks before accessing paths outside the project. V2 does not: external_directory is allowed by default.
Plugins now run in a worker instead of directly inside the hub.
SessionStart array Handlers that run once when a new conversation session starts, before the first model invocation.

Add these ordered rules to opencode.jsonc : { "$schema" : "https://opencode.ai/config.json" , "permissions" : [ { "action" : "shell" , "resource" : "*" , "effect" : "ask" }, { "action" : "shell" , "resource" : "git status *" , "effect" : "allow" }, { "action" : "shell" , "resource" : "git diff *" , "effect" : "allow" }, { "action" : "shell" , "resource" : "git push *" , "effect" : "deny" }, ], } The last matching rule wins, so the specific exceptions follow the broad rule.
workspace skills take priority over global skills
Bind subagents by their parent's hooks, mode and approvals
# .github/workflows/code-review.yml [...] use_single_comment: true [...] prompt: "code-review"
`hooks.validate` runs last every time and is never cached; the pull request check runs every hook, including `validate`.
The Memory setting is a user setting. A value in workspace settings has no effect.
Team-owned `SKILL.md` files live in the factory definition and are shared across the factory or scoped to one agent.
Each subscription names its own Amp project: a workspace project or one of your personal projects.
Added `decider: "person"` to a mod's `tool.check` answer: only the permission dialog or a host's callback can approve the ask
`browser_open` ... current origin and all origins
Agent Manager can run a custom agent
`edit` rules ... no longer constrain the subagents it starts

Remote MCP definitions are available across Amp clients without a local settings file. Store one definition in your personal settings, a workspace, or a project: Some servers need more headers on every request, such as an organization ID. Amp encrypts secret values and never shows them again; leave one blank to keep it.
Added `sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces` so sandboxed commands on Linux can create user namespaces (Chromium, rootless podman); this lets them get around the sandbox's file protections
support custom OTLP headers in telemetry configuration
You can set policies on your personal servers. Workspace admins can set them on workspace servers, and project managers on project servers.
Kiro IDE and CLI V3 also support one line, an inclusive line range, or a one-level folder listing:
#[serde(rename = "PreModelRequest", default)] pub pre_model_request: Vec<MatcherGroup>, #[serde(rename = "PostModelRequest", default)] pub post_model_request: Vec<MatcherGroup>,
`fail_closed: true` blocks the action a hook guards when the hook itself fails to run, instead of going ahead without it.
`PostToolUse` hooks can replace a tool result before the model reads it with `hookSpecificOutput.updatedToolOutput`, for example to redact content a tool returned.
Set `removable: true` on an image or attachment field to let the user remove it before confirming
Bitbucket, GitLab, and other HTTPS Git hosts are supported in orbs.
set the optional timeout field on that server in milliseconds
A positive value, in seconds, replaces both limits.
When set, all other tools on the server are hidden.
Kiro CLI asks you to trust a folder before it loads that folder's hooks, agents, MCP servers, steering, workflows, or language server configuration.
turning the feature on no longer kicks off a workflow by itself, so one runs only when you ask for it.
A hook can end the agent's turn from any event with `stop: "<reason>"` in its output (Claude-format hooks: `continue: false` / `stopReason`).
